name: The Sebright Arms
summary: A pub with a gig room in its basement. The building was once a cinema and music hall, and it is where Courtney Barnett, Charli XCX and Catfish and the Bottlemen played early in their careers.

music.notes: Live gigs in the basement music room, below the ground-floor bar.

accessibility.notes: Gigs are held downstairs in the basement; the pub itself is on the ground floor.

evidence.quote: Historically a movie theatre & music hall. Now an east-end boozer and music venue with early shows by Courtney Barnett, Charli XCX & Catfish and the Bottlemen to it's name.
Capacity 150 Address 31-35 Coate St, London E2 9AG
Ground floor pub with established live music venue in the basement
Our gig venue in the basement is also a popular spot for a private celebration
